page_title: CRY 0-0 BOU | Crystal Palace v Bournemouth 19/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+1' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) is coming onto the pitch as Ismaila Sarr cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
86' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Samuel Barrott lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
86' Crystal Palace string together a series of short passes.
84' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Adam Smith is replaced by Julian Araujo (Bournemouth).
78' The resulting set piece from Crystal Palace is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
77' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) takes the corner but it's cleared. The ball is out of play and Crystal Palace manage to earn a corner.
77' Crystal Palace spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake. Crystal Palace will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
75' Oliver Glasner decides to make a substitution. Adam Wharton will be replaced by Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace).
75' Oliver Glasner has decided to substitute Jean-Philippe Mateta and he is replaced by Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace).
71' Samuel Barrott shows a yellow card to Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
69' Here's the change. Dango Ouattara leaves the pitch and David Brooks (Bournemouth) comes on as a substitute.
69' The corner is swung in but Bournemouth can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
67' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.

65' Evanilson (Bournemouth) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Dean Henderson. This effort really didn't trouble him.
64' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Crystal Palace.

63' Decent spell from Crystal Palace here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in. Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
62' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
61' Substitution. Tyler Adams is replaced by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth).
59' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) whips in the free kick, but one of the defenders comfortably clears the ball away.
58' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle and signals a foul after Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) brought his opponent down.
57' The possession of the ball – 31:69.
54' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
49' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
47' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) disagrees with the decision of the referee and is given a yellow card.
47' Samuel Barrott shows a yellow card to Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) for a tough tackle.
46' Crystal Palace can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Oliver Glasner gives a chance to Jefferson Lerma and Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is off.
46' Half-time substitution. Andoni Iraola decided to make a change. Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is replaced by Lewis Cook.
46' Referee Samuel Barrott blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bournemouth comes to nothing.

44' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick.
44' The Bournemouth players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
41' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
37' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Samuel Barrott signals.

34' Milos Kerkez finds Evanilson (Bournemouth) unmarked on the edge of the box, but his thunderbolt of shot goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
32' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
32' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
29' Yellow card. Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
25' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alex Scott (Bournemouth) was quite harsh and Samuel Barrott didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
24' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

23' Bournemouth are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
18' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
17' Bournemouth take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
17' Evanilson (Bournemouth) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bournemouth.
16' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
15' Samuel Barrott has a clear sight and sees a foul from Will Hughes (Crystal Palace).
14' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) tries to find Jean-Philippe Mateta, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
11' Good defending. Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) tries to find Justin Kluivert inside the box, but the pass is cut out. The ball is out of play. Bournemouth will have a throw-in.
10' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle after Alex Scott (Bournemouth) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
8' Evanilson (Bournemouth) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
7' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
5' The corner from Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) is intercepted by the defence.
5' Crystal Palace move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession. Crystal Palace force a corner. They send men into the box.
3' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
2' A spell of possession for Bournemouth in an attempt to control the game.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Bournemouth will have the kick-off.
Samuel Barrott is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
